title: Rules or Character? Scaling Laws for AI Safety Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.13345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) safety systems combine character shaping (e.g., Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback [RLHF], Constitutional AI), which modifies behavioral distributions at training time, with rule enforcement (e.g., output filters, safety classifiers), which blocks harmful outputs at inference time, yet little formal analysis exists on how their optimal balance should change as deployment scales increase. We introduce a stylized comparative-statics model that parameterizes safety design as a resource allocation alpha in [0,1] between these two approaches, incorporating scale-dependent filter degradation, common-mode failures, and character fragility -- the risk that shaped behavior degrades or collapses under novel conditions. translated_title: 规则还是品格？AI安全设计的规模定律
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13345v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人工智能（AI）安全系统结合了品格塑造（例如，基于人类反馈的强化学习[RLHF]、宪法AI），在训练时修改行为分布，以及规则执行（例如，输出过滤器、安全分类器），在推理时阻止有害输出，然而，对于随着部署规模增加，其最佳平衡应如何变化，目前缺乏正式分析。我们引入了一个简化的比较静态模型，将安全设计参数化为这两种方法之间的资源分配alpha（在[0,1]范围内），并纳入规模相关的过滤器退化、共因故障和品格脆弱性——即塑造的行为在新条件下退化或崩溃的风险。在乘法帕累托损害模型下，我们推导出闭式期望危害，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟补充尾部风险（CVaR）分析。在三种情景（乐观、中等、悲观）中，我们展示了最优alpha如何随规模变化，并识别出在何种条件下，品格塑造或规则执行成为主导策略。我们的发现提供了可操作的见解，用于在规模增加时设计可扩展的AI安全系统。
tldr: 本文提出了一个正式模型，分析AI安全设计中品格塑造与规则执行的最优资源分配如何随部署规模变化，并揭示了不同情景下的主导策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a formal model analyzing how the optimal resource allocation between character shaping and rule enforcement in AI safety design changes with deployment scale, revealing dominant strategies across different scenarios.
